_comment: Checkpoint modes for the QML Lab (docs/lab, D4/D5; revised 2026-11-15, harness review).
HUMAN_APPROVE blocks until a person signs. HUMAN_SPOTCHECK proceeds; a sample is reviewed within 48 h.
AGENT proceeds; the decision is logged; escalations still fire.
Lane since 2026-11-15: people sign the spec AND the frozen scorer at CP2 (permanent HUMAN_APPROVE).
CP3 is AGENT: it passes only when lab.tools.autonomy cp3-check finds a frozen scorer, a clean lock and
guard, and every gate computed; otherwise that instance falls back to HUMAN_APPROVE automatically.
CP1 stays HUMAN_APPROVE but is signed weekly in one sitting (cadence weekly-batch, autonomy sign-batch).
CP4 stays HUMAN_APPROVE until replay evals exist; CP5 (promotion) is permanently HUMAN_APPROVE.
Step-down otherwise as before: retire_rule.consecutive_runs clean sign-offs AND the CP's evals passing;
only Tsahi approves a step-down; any material finding restores the previous mode automatically.

history.evidence: Harness review https://claude.ai/artifact/UaDJsXykpobdumS5NKfvVM; Tsahi approved all steps in the project thread. CP3 is mechanical once the scorer is frozen; per-instance fallback to HUMAN_APPROVE when cp3-check fails.
Same review: CP1 signed in a weekly batch instead of per program (3 sign-offs in 46 days under the per-program queue).
